moments.title: Premier League Transfer Deadline Day
moments.blurb: The summer transfer window for Premier League clubs closes tonight, with teams rushing to complete last-minute deals.

angles.name: Final Hours
angles.copy: It's transfer deadline day! Who do you think your team needs to sign before 11pm? The clock is ticking!

angles.name: Last Minute Drama
angles.copy: Will there be any shocks before the Premier League transfer window slams shut tonight at 11pm BST? Get ready for the drama!

moments.title: Ariana Grande's Final London Show
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Ariana Grande concludes the London leg of her 'The Eternal Sunshine Tour' tonight at the O2 Arena.

angles.name: Last Night Ari
angles.copy: Tonight's the last chance to catch Ariana Grande on her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' at London's O2! Who was lucky enough to get tickets?

angles.name: Eternal Sunshine Tour Ends London
angles.copy: Ariana Grande wraps up her incredible London run tonight. What was your favourite moment from her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour'?

moments.title: Dolly Parton's 'Jolene' Re-enters UK Top 10
moments.blurb: Following her passing last week at age 80, Dolly Parton's classic 'Jolene' has posthumously re-entered the Official UK Singles Chart Top 10 at number 9.

angles.name: Jolene's Chart Return
angles.copy: A fitting tribute: Dolly Parton's iconic 'Jolene' is back in the UK Top 10 after her passing. A timeless classic still loved by so many.

angles.name: Remembering Dolly
angles.copy: Dolly Parton's legacy lives on, with 'Jolene' re-entering the charts. What's your favourite Dolly song or memory?

moments.title: Back to School Season Begins
moments.blurb: For many across the UK, September 1st marks the official return to school for a new academic year.

angles.name: School Bells Ring
angles.copy: Back to school for many today! Wishing all students, teachers, and parents a smooth start to the new academic year.

angles.name: Autumn Term Starts
angles.copy: New uniforms, new books, new routines! The autumn term is officially underway for lots of schools. Good luck everyone!

moments.title: Happy 69th Birthday, Gloria Estefan
moments.blurb: Legendary Cuban-American singer and 'Queen of Latin Pop' Gloria Estefan turns 69 today.

angles.name: Conga Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the incredible Gloria Estefan! What's your favourite Miami Sound Machine classic?

angles.name: Estefan Turns 69
angles.copy: Celebrate Gloria Estefan's 69th birthday with a spin of one of her iconic hits! 'Conga', 'Anything For You', or 'Coming Out Of The Dark'?

moments.title: Happy 80th Birthday, Barry Gibb
moments.blurb: Founding member of the iconic Bee Gees, Sir Barry Gibb, celebrates his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bee Gee's 80th
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the legendary Sir Barry Gibb! From 'Stayin' Alive' to 'How Deep Is Your Love', what's your top Bee Gees track?

angles.name: Happy Birthday Barry Gibb
angles.copy: Celebrating 80 years of disco, pop, and songwriting genius! Happy Birthday to the one and only Barry Gibb of the Bee Gees.

moments.title: The Black Keys Play London
moments.blurb: American rock duo The Black Keys are performing in London tonight, with another date tomorrow.

angles.name: Black Keys Live
angles.copy: The Black Keys are bringing their blues-rock sound to London tonight! Who's heading to see them tear up the stage?

angles.name: London Rock Tonight
angles.copy: Two nights of The Black Keys in London start tonight! Get ready for some serious riffs.

moments.title: UK Set for 'Very Warm Spells' This Week
moments.blurb: After a mixed weekend, parts of the UK, especially the south, are forecast to experience 'very warm spells' with temperatures potentially reaching 28-29C around September 5-7.

angles.name: September Sun Returns
angles.copy: Don't pack away the shorts just yet! The Met Office is forecasting 'very warm spells' for parts of the UK this week, with temperatures climbing.

angles.name: Mini Heatwave Incoming?
angles.copy: Sunshine and higher temperatures are on the cards for the UK this week! Get ready for some late summer warmth.

moments.title: Happy 42nd Birthday, Joe Trohman
moments.blurb: Fall Out Boy guitarist and co-founder Joe Trohman celebrates his 42nd birthday today.

angles.name: FOB Guitarist's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a rockin' happy 42nd birthday to Joe Trohman of Fall Out Boy! What's your favourite FOB guitar riff?

moments.title: Happy 37th Birthday, Bill Kaulitz
moments.blurb: German singer and frontman of Tokio Hotel, Bill Kaulitz, turns 37 today.

angles.name: Tokio Hotel Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 37th birthday to the distinctive voice of Tokio Hotel, Bill Kaulitz! What's your favourite track from the band?

moments.title: Bon Jovi Kicks Off Wembley Shows
moments.blurb: Rock legends Bon Jovi begin a series of three highly anticipated shows at Wembley Stadium this Friday as part of their 'Forever' tour.

angles.name: Bon Jovi at Wembley
angles.copy: Get ready, London! Bon Jovi bring their 'Forever' tour to Wembley Stadium this Friday for the first of three massive shows. Which classic are you hoping to hear?

angles.name: It's My Life, It's Now or Never
angles.copy: Bon Jovi are back at Wembley this week! Three nights of pure rock anthems await. Dig out your leather jackets!

moments.title: New Amazon Motoring Show Premieres
moments.blurb: A new motoring show featuring James, Francis, and Thomas (likely a new iteration of *The Grand Tour*) premieres on Amazon Prime Video this Friday, September 4th.

angles.name: New Motoring Mayhem
angles.copy: Buckle up! The iconic trio of James, Francis, and Thomas are back with a brand new motoring show, hitting Amazon Prime Video this Friday.

angles.name: Petrolheads Rejoice
angles.copy: Your weekend viewing is sorted! A new motoring adventure arrives on Amazon this Friday. Who's excited to see what James, Francis, and Thomas get up to?

moments.title: Niall Horan's UK Arena Tour Kicks Off This Month
moments.blurb: Niall Horan's 'Dinner Party Live On Tour' begins this September, with his biggest UK arena run yet, including dates in Birmingham, Newcastle, Manchester, Glasgow, Sheffield, and London.

angles.name: Niall Horan Takes UK
angles.copy: Niall Horan is bringing his 'Dinner Party Live On Tour' to arenas across the UK this month! Where are you planning to see him?

angles.name: One Direction Star Tours
angles.copy: From Birmingham to London, Niall Horan's massive UK arena tour starts in September. Get ready for a dinner party like no other!

moments.title: Happy 45th Birthday, Beyoncé
moments.blurb: Global icon and 'Queen Bey' Beyoncé Knowles-Carter celebrates her 45th birthday this Friday.

angles.name: Queen Bey Turns 45
angles.copy: Wishing a phenomenal 45th birthday to the incomparable Beyoncé this Friday! What's your all-time favourite Beyoncé anthem?

angles.name: Happy Birthday Beyonce
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate Queen Bey's 45th this Friday! It's time to play your favourite Beyoncé hits loud.

moments.title: Happy 51st Birthday, Mark Ronson
moments.blurb: Award-winning DJ, songwriter, and producer Mark Ronson turns 51 this Friday.

angles.name: Mark Ronson's 51st
angles.copy: Wishing a funky happy 51st birthday to the brilliant Mark Ronson this Friday! What's your favourite track he's produced or featured on?

angles.name: Uptown Funk Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrate Mark Ronson turning 51 this Friday by cranking up some 'Uptown Funk'! A true music chameleon.

moments.title: Happy 83rd Birthday, Gloria Gaynor
moments.blurb: Disco legend Gloria Gaynor, famous for 'I Will Survive', celebrates her 83rd birthday this Sunday.

angles.name: I Will Survive at 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Gloria Gaynor this Sunday! Her anthem 'I Will Survive' remains as powerful as ever.
